name: ExTyrannomon
main_effect:
When any of your [Ver.5] trait Digimon would digivolve into this card, for each of their face-down digivolution cards, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
＜Fortitude＞ (When this Digimon with digivolution cards is deleted, play this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, by trashing this Digimon's bottom face-down digivolution card, return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon with the lowest DP to the hand.
source_effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, trash their top security card.
